next_v5.new_case_rule: abs(actual settled error)<=0.2mL AND total-label spill0 AND full home including settle<=5 raw physical seconds
next_v5.candidate_rule: only all-case-feasible candidates compare mean raw action time; otherwise mean absolute error then total spill; invalid physics/measurement/mass excluded

limitations: Archived failed research experiment; literal source/cache pins remain. Missing private historical protocols or NPZ inputs is an explicit refusal, not turnkey reproduction.
No original raw step logs, NPZ caches, private paths or videos are published. Public source transforms change source SHA; do not resume original logs with them.
V4 used its original unsafe/home-late/precision/time selection, with overall and per-target MAE<=0.1 and worst<=0.2 release gates. V5 user rules do not reselect or relabel V4.
All eighteen heldout executions meet5s home/zero spill/no late-drop physical gates; all eighteen miss0.2mL. Candidate is validation-recommended, not task-successful.
Motion is kinematic pregrasp, with privileged particle-mass metrology; no frictional grasp, reaction torque, camera or real-scale calibration.
Only two train, two validation and three test seeds; 48training executions reuse six initial conditions. No new GUI/default deployment.
